name: Cross-Body Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a high plank with hands beneath your shoulders and body straight from head to heels.
Brace your core and drive one knee diagonally under your torso toward your opposite elbow.
Return that foot back to the plank as you quickly drive the other knee across.
Continue alternating knees at a steady, controlled pace throughout the exercise.
tips: Keep your shoulders stacked over your wrists as your feet move.
Avoid letting your hips bounce high or sag toward the floor as you speed up.
